text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship's angler spirit yearns for a hundred-squid haul! She swears to battle to hold the territory where two ocean currents meet. Now, to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship is racing in the Arima Kinen! And, for whatever reason, she's fired up to take on Eishin Flash as an angler.
